headline: S&P 500 rises as investors rotate out of technology into healthcare
summary: The S&P 500 ended higher as investors concerned about tech valuations shifted capital into defensive sectors like healthcare and consumer stocks.
why: Sector rotation reflects changing macroeconomic sentiment, showing where institutional investors seek shelter during periods of tech market volatility.

impacts.name: Healthcare
impacts.why: Inflows from rotating investors provide buying support to non-cyclical healthcare equities.

why_moved: Disillusionment with high-flying AI stocks drove funds toward defensive, cash-flow-stable healthcare businesses.
